description: Create a paid Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 video job. Pass image_url or an official likeness reference binding to use image-to-video and preserve the creator shown in the approved source image; otherwise BAMF uses text-to-video. Poll with bamf.get_job; success returns a BAMF-hosted MP4 media asset plus the provider request receipt.

image_url.description: Optional HTTPS start frame. When present, BAMF uses Seedance 2.5 image-to-video instead of text-to-video.

reference_bindings.description: Optional official/inspiration reference contract. The first official likeness image becomes the Seedance image-to-video start frame.

asset_url.description: HTTPS URL for the immutable asset version named by the binding.

binding.description: A complete bamf.multimodal-reference-binding/v1 object with consent and provenance.

name: bamf.generate_video
